lines.text: Many learners say: i am a student.
I is always a big letter.

data.why: I is always a big letter.

native.hook: 英语的 I 永远要大写！
native.tip: 汉语没有大小写，所以容易把 i 写成小写。英语里 I（我）无论在哪里都要大写。
native.caption: 你是不是也会写 “i am a student.”😅 汉语没有大小写，所以容易写成 i，英语的 I 一定要大写：“I am a student.”跟着 Carlos 老师写一写！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I am a student.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: Chinese has no capital letters, but English always writes I big.
en.caption: Do you write “i am a student.” 😅 Chinese has no capital letters, but English always writes I big: “I am a student.” Write it with Carlos! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
